meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (1MA1/3H, Monday 11 November 2024, P75162A). Derived metadata only — question numbers, marks, mark-scheme codes and skill tags. No exam question text transcribed.
meta.note: Coded in the same sitting as EDEXCEL-NOV24-F-P3. The crossover block is 3F q17–q25 = 3H q1–q9, contiguous, and the marks match item for item (2, 2, 2, 4, 5, 4, 2, 2, 3). Coded WITH mark_split. All 23 (Total for Question) lines were recovered and the paper sums to the printed 80.

coding_notes: q1–q9 are 3F q17–q25 and carry identical skill tags, kinds and mark splits to that file, by design.

q5 (percentage profit on a ratio-split stock) tagged ratio BEFORE percentage_change, matching its Foundation twin — see EDEXCEL-NOV24-F-P3's note for the reasoning and for why the topic column on that paper made it matter.
q13 tagged congruence_and_similarity before area_of_a_trapezium: two of the three marks are length scale factors on the nested triangles, and the trapezium area is the last step.
q12b (depreciation over two years, find the rate) tagged growth_and_decay, not reverse_percentage — the mark scheme's route is a two-year multiplier, which is that node. q10 IS a reverse_percentage.

q18a (capture-recapture) tagged proportion then sampling. The mark scheme's marks are both for equating two ratios, so proportion leads; sampling is what q18b's assumption is about and is the reason the item belongs to Probability and Data at all. Note that every Probability-and-Data path already bottoms out in sampling, so this tag is cheap.
q11 tagged sector_calculations: the perimeter includes two radii, so the arc length must be recovered before the angle, and the answer is the reflex angle.

q23 tagged completing_the_square first, then sketching_functions: three of the five marks are the completed square and the turning point in terms of the parameter, and only the last is the sketch itself.
